title: A complexity analysis of the F4 Gröbner basis algorithm with tracer data
summary: We provide a new complexity bound for the computation of grevlex Gröbner bases in the generic zero-dimensional case, relying on Moreno-Socías' conjecture. We first formalize a property of regular sequences that implies a well-known folklore consequence, which we call the increasing degree property. We then derive a new understanding of the selection of pairs in the F4 algorithm based on Moreno-Socías' conjecture.
